**Notes on each pick**

- **Parent and Tot at the gym:**
  - 
The class involves parent participation and is led by a coach through a warm-up, games, music and circuits on all gymnastic events.

  - 
It is a fall session of 14 (13) weeks, September 12 to December 18, and registration opened July 20th.

  - The session is already under way today, so I can't tell whether spots are left.
  - No price is on the pages I read.
  - I read the Saturday times off a PDF grid, and the day columns were hard to parse. The gym's own schedule is the one to trust.
- **Pre-school Drop In:**
  - 
It costs $15 for one parent and up to 4 children, with no pre-registration needed.

  - 
It runs Tuesday and Thursday, 9:30am to 12:00pm.

  - The gym's pages disagree on the start date. 
One says drop-in begins September 15th and runs to June 26.
 
Another says October 9.
 Both dates have passed, but it's worth confirming.
  - The same pages give the age as under 4 in one place and "4 and under" in another.
  - 
It is closed Dec. 22 to Jan 5, per the drop-ins page.
 The preschool page says Dec. 18 to Jan 5.
- **Parent & Tot Skating:**
  - 
It is for children under 6 with an adult on the ice, and children must wear a helmet.

  - 
The fees are adult $4.00 and child $2.50.

  - The page I read doesn't give days or times, so I left `when` out.

I didn't find a posted fall Parent & Tot swim schedule, only the summer one, so I left swimming out.
